svg.title: How deep DeeCure looks
svg.desc: DeeCure looks eight layers deep, each one nested inside the one above: apps and processes, services and jobs, packages and updates, network, security and backups, storage, kernel and firmware, and the hardware itself. A scan walks down the layers, 117 checks in all. On the right, live readings move, the health score fills to 92, and what the scan found appears as plain sentences, each with its path down the layers: the firewall is off, the main disk will be full in about 12 days, the SSD has 92% of its life left, and battery health is 84%.
svg.text: 8 layers, 117 checks, 55 warnings: from the apps you see to the chips inside
Layer 2 of 8: Services, start-up, and jobs
All 8 layers checked: 2 things to look at
CPU, memory, battery, and network per app · /proc, cgroups
Failed units, restart loops, boot chain, timers · systemd
Security updates, broken installs, checksums · apt, dpkg
Wi-Fi, DNS, every open port, link errors · /proc/net
Space, days until full, ext4 errors · statvfs

g.text: Main disk full in about 12 days
